label: Town of Milton
header:
# Town of Milton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 15; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Milton (official website), Selectboard page: lists the five selectboard members as Darren Adams (Chair), Michael Morgan (Vice Chair), Diane Barrows (Clerk of the board), Leland Morgan, and Betsy Paret

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Milton's selectboard as Darren Adams (Chair), Diane Barrows, Leland Morgan, and Michael Morgan (Vice Chair), with one further member
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129 (Town of Milton): section 202(a)(1) provides for five selectpersons elected at the annual meeting
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129 (Town of Milton): sections 202(a)(2) and 203(b) provide for a Town Clerk elected for a three-year term
Town of Milton (official website), staff directory: lists Kristin Beers as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Kristin Beers as Milton's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Kristin Beers as Milton's town clerk
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129 (Town of Milton): sections 202(a)(3) and 203(c) provide for a Town Treasurer elected for a three-year term
Town of Milton (official website), staff directory: lists John Gifford as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists John C. Gifford as Milton's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names John C. Gifford as Milton's town treasurer
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129 (Town of Milton): sections 202(a)(4) and 203(d) provide for five elected Library Trustees

Milton Public Library Board of Trustees minutes, June 2, 2026 (Town of Milton AgendaCenter): lists the trustees as Cathy Vadnais (Chair), Henry Bonges (Vice Chair), Beth Bouchard (Treasurer), Gillian Taylor (Secretary), and Joe Duquette
Milton Public Library Board of Trustees minutes, March 24, 2026 (Town of Milton AgendaCenter): lists the same five trustees: Vadnais, Bonges, Bouchard, Taylor, and Duquette
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 129 (Town of Milton): sections 202(a)(6) and 203(f) provide for a Champlain Water District Representative elected for a three-year term

Champlain Water District, February 17, 2026 regular meeting packet (including the January 20, 2026 meeting minutes): the District's January 20, 2026 regular meeting minutes list John Gifford, Milton, among the commissioners present
Champlain Water District, 2021-2022 Annual Report: the report's board table names John Gifford as the Town of Milton's commissioner (Lisa Schaeffler, alternate)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Milton justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024

Vermont General Assembly, Representative Leland Morgan's member page and biography: Representative Leland Morgan's biography gives his mailing address as 23 Morgan Rd., Milton -- the address the justice of the peace listing prints for Leland Morgan -- and states he is presently a Justice of the Peace; the Milton justice of the peace membership reuses his existing person record
